author: Kyle Ingerson
title: Rising Sun 11U baseball all-stars win District 5 title - NewsBreak
text:
By Kyle Ingerson ,
4 hours ago
CHESAPEAKE CITY - Rising Sun Little League’s 9-10-11 baseball all-stars defeated Chesapeake City 10-9 to capture the District 5 championship Monday evening.
The contest originally began Saturday before being suspended due to inclement weather. Chesapeake City led 6-3 in the bottom of the third inning when play was suspended.
When play resumed Monday, Rising Sun rallied to take the lead. Rising Sun scored four runs via an RBI single by Levi Haywood, a two-run single by Bryce Brogan and a Chesapeake City error that scored Brogan. Rising Sun extended its advantage to two in the bottom of the fourth on an RBI by Emmett Schappel.
Chesapeake City retook the lead with three runs in the top of the fifth on a passed ball that scored Ethan Long, an RBI groundout by Grayson Gralewski and a wild pitch that scored Jordan Geissler. However, Rising Sun scored two runs to retake the lead in the bottom half of the inning on an RBI groundout by Brantley Barber and an RBI single by Chase Powers.
Despite the tying run reaching scoring position in the top of the sixth, Barber struck out the side to secure the victory for Rising Sun. Barber recorded six strikeouts over three innings of relief in a winning effort on the mound.
Chesapeake City opened the game Saturday with two runs in the top of the first on an RBI single by Geissler and a passed ball that scored Gralewski. Rising Sun responded with three runs in the bottom half of the inning via an RBI single by Haywood, a sacrifice fly by Brogan and an RBI single by Declan Minks.
Chesapeake City later responded with four runs in the top of the third to take a three-run lead. The runs came via a wild pitch that scored Liam LaBarre, an RBI single by Gralewski, an RBI double by SJ Rothwell and a passed ball that scored Rothwell.
With the win, Rising Sun advances to the state tournament, which will take place at Kent Island Little League beginning July 11.
